verdict.rationale: ImageMagick is an image-processing tool and library, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack shows only a CLI, language bindings, and an llms.txt file, with no official MCP server. The CLI, bindings, and llms.txt are developer building blocks or adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
